mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases the discount rate and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE rises for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary regime that increases discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent 3-month increase in the unemployment rate and a 3-month decline in payroll employment (UNRATE up, PAYEMS down) signals a deepening labor market downturn, which increases recession risk and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 0.5% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and lower earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO declines for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) combined with a 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening demand and inflation pressures easing, which reduces discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and RSAFS both decline for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL and RSAFS both decline for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) signals strengthening residential investment and economic activity, which raises earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST rises for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05).
